authorization: Maintainer requested acceleration and parallel execution on 2026-11-10
scope: CPU final serving and subsequent evidence preparation only. Existing six-device GPU lanes and all completed GPU samples continue unchanged.
lanes: One fresh single-thread process per lane; bind each lane to one distinct physical core and its available SMT siblings. Derive and record CPU/core/socket/NUMA relationships from the actual host. Each model always uses its assigned lane for all methods and serial references.
start_gate: All GPU training, quality and final GPU timing must finish before CPU measurement begins. CPU main grid is parallel; the serial reference cohort follows after all main workers finish.
immutable: Retain every previously frozen candidate, request, index, cache setting, quality budget and repetition count. No performance measurement selects or drops candidates.
serial_reference_selection: At the primary registered budget (.001 SGNS loss or .5 percentage-point LLM quality), measure every family winner plus raw-fp32/fp16/int8, dense-fp32 and native-none-fp32/fp16/int8. Long-table references use ordinary inference, cache 0 and DATrie; additionally retain the hash-index controls for raw FP32 and tree-DATrie candidates. LLM references use the same original-key CPU queries and cache 0.
serial_reference_checks: One fresh worker at a time on the same assigned physical core. Require identical complete decoded-row hashes and actual query output hashes; publish paired parallel/serial latency ratios including large discrepancies.
timing_claim: Full-grid measurements describe fixed-core queries on a shared host, not host-exclusive latency. Independent serial references support primary-budget comparisons. Report core affinity, host load and cohort explicitly; do not present a parallel speedup as an engine optimization.
evidence_preparation: Batch Git object reads and compress independent deterministic release capsules with up to four workers after measurements. Content, member order, hashes and verification rules stay fixed.
